section_4_6_sentences: Cj [is] the set of fault modes that are formed of satellite faults included in constellation j (and included in the list established above).
If a fault cannot be monitored, it is not included in the list of fault modes and we move to the next one.
In this case, these events must be removed from the list of faults (and their integrity risk subtracted from the available budget).
add_reference.open_reading: MAAST's reading is used: a constellation-plus-satellite mode belongs to Cj when all affected satellites are in j; unobservable selected modes are filtered and charged through Eq. (18).

consolidation_case_pl_difference.cause: The selected mode sets and Eq. (17) priors agree. MAAST applies the optional Eqs. (35)-(37) second pass, removes modes whose summed coordinate allocation reaches one, and recomputes thresholds and PLs. The independent reference retains the first-pass Eqs. (31)-(33) roots. Both choices are allowed by the ADD.
consolidation_case_pl_difference.add_sentence: This possible loss of performance can be mitigated by: first, identifying the modes for which we are overestimating the integrity risk, second, by excluding them from the list of monitored faults, and, third, by recomputing the thresholds and Protection Levels with the new list.
